item: H-COTRAIN — does joint WM+planner training overwrite physical-world state?
_evidence_class: MEASURED (ours; pod5 p1-cotrain-{5000,10000,15000,20000}/ + the banked 30k row)
design: the v5f run's own lambda_plan curriculum (0 until 2000, linear ramp to 8000, then 1.0) crossed with the restored milestone checkpoints - a within-run dose-response curve for planner-gradient exposure, probed with the SAME frozen instrument

spectrum_SIGReg.verdict: SIGReg VALIDATED - no progressive collapse under joint training; effective rank EXPANDS 53%

verdict: H-COTRAIN REJECTED within the measured range
reasoning: The pre-registered CONFIRM condition required a scene variable above 0.15 R2(enc) at 5000 to DECLINE by >=0.15 absolute while ego dynamics held, or effective rank to shrink >20%. Neither happened: every probed variable rose monotonically (curvature 0.213->0.513 encoded, 0.225->0.704 predicted), effective rank grew 53%, and the P1 battery went from FAIL to PASS at 20000. Joint training is associated with IMPROVING physical decodability.
honest_scope: All four milestones sit AT or PAST the lambda ramp (lambda ~0.5 at 5000, 1.0 from 8000), so the lowest-exposure reference is lambda=0.5, not 0. The clean control is the --lambda-plan 0 arm the prereg named; it is cheap and is v6's S-W stage anyway. This result therefore rejects EROSION-under-joint-training, and does not by itself prove joint training is optimal.
transient_note: A real transient IS visible: predicted-latent yaw_rate/curvature DIP sharply at 10000 (0.177 / 0.050), right after the ramp reaches lambda=1.0 at 8000, then recover and overshoot. The planner gradient disturbs the predictive readout when it arrives; the system re-organises rather than degrading.
consequence: The staged v6 recipe stands on the FIELD evidence (Drive-JEPA / V-JEPA2-AC / DINO-WM) and on the consumer-invalidation finding (W7-FULL), NOT on an erosion claim - which is now measured false in this range. P2 (nuisance non-retention) FAILS at every milestone and remains a separate standing defect.
